photos.c: Left: Ernest Obeng gains a clear victory over Steve White (Oxford City) in the 100 metres during the league match at Wimbledon.

Back page: Ernest Obeng from Anum, Ghana, had an outstanding first season with Belgrave Harriers with 12 wins out of 12 races in the league, 5th in the A.A.A. 100m final, victor in the G.L.C. 100m and 200m, Club Champion over the same distances and twice equalling our Club Record for the 100m.

Front Cover.
Ernest Obeng of Ghana and Belgrave Harriers beats Olympic 200 metre Champion Don Quarrie of Jamaica over 100 metres at the Philips Night of Athletics, Crystal Palace May 24th.
Ernest Obeng - delighted to receive a tribute from fellow Belgravians smiles even more broadly as President Bill Merrimen relates his own best sprint times!
Pan African Sprint Champion Ernest Obeng's fine series of races in 1980 resulted in him winning the Tommy Green Cup for the 3rd successive year.
At last! Ernest Obeng's look of joy records his Coca Cola meeting victory in the 100m over Olympic Champion Alan Wells.
The power of Ernest's sprinting is beautifully captured in this photo by Eileen Langsley.

Ernest Obeng's Belgrave Honours badge well to the fore in the Peugeot Games held at the Crystal Palace on July 13th, - probably the last occasion he will wear Ghana's colours as he has vowed not to compete again for the Country which treated him so shabbily in Los Angeles Olympics. Wells won in 10.46.
